entry.name: mute~
entry.digest: Disable signal processing in a subpatch
entry.description: mute~ provides an easy way to disable only the signal objects in a subpatcher. (An alternative is to use pcontrol, but this disables all objects (i.e. MIDI) and is slightly slower.)

messages.name: int
messages.description: 1 turns off the signal processing in all objects contained in the subpatch connected to theobject's outlet, 0 turns it back on.

messages.name: list
messages.digest: Enable/disable processing in subpatchers of connected subpatchers
messages.description: Sending the listto theobject will mute any subpatchers of theobject to which the message is sent. Similarly, sending the listto theobject will unmute any subpatchers of theobject.

inlets.digest: 1 Mutes Signal Objects In patcher, 0 Unmutes
